Hi Marta — please find our completed responses below and attached. We focused answers on operational guarantees and the contractual controls NordicBank asked about. Attached: residency_matrix_olga_review.xlsx (completed), redwood-region-availability-2026.pdf (operational appendix).

Key points (summary):
- EU-only execution: For all EU-tagged tenants we provide EU-hosted inference on our EU clusters (Frankfurt, Amsterdam). For Hosted customers we apply routing policies that prefer EU endpoints; for Dedicated we reserve physical pools in EU regions and provide region pinning; for Private we support fully on-prem or VPC deployments.

- Preventing cross-border fallback: By default our runtime may fallback to a non-EU region only under defined exceptional conditions (sustained capacity exhaustion > 5 minutes, catastrophic hardware failure, or cross-region network partition). Customers can eliminate non-EU fallback by contracting Reserved Capacity (Dedicated) or Private deployment. We will include explicit language in the contract: "Redwood will not route EU-labeled tenant inference to non-EU regions except as required for emergency continuity and with prior written notice".

- Routing controls & observability: We support tag-based routing (tenant.region = eu), per-tenant routing policies, and an override lock for customers with Dedicated capacity. Our Console exposes token-level routing traces and a per-request region header for audit.

- Logs and retention: Audit logs and metadata are retained in the control plane; EU-hosted tenants can elect to have audit logs stored in an EU-only S3-compatible bucket (with KMS keys scoped to EU). Default control-plane retention is 90 days for operational logs; customers can request extended retention (12/24/36 months) via add-on. Exports are available as CSV/JSON.

- Data in transit & at rest: All inference payloads are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256 via managed KMS). For Private deployments we support customer-managed HSM/KMS.

- Testing & attestations: We can supply region placement diagrams, a completed SOC2 + infrastructure control list, and redacted audit logs for review under an NDA.

Next steps / asks from NordicBank:
1) Please confirm whether you want a Dedicated reserved pool in EU to prevent fallback; we can provide pricing and capacity options.
2) If you require audit logs to be kept in EU only, we will share the steps for enabling EU-only logging + an SLA addendum.

Attachments: residency_matrix_olga_review.xlsx (completed answers), redwood-region-availability-2026.pdf (operational appendix)
